verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents adding and editing the Chart of Accounts in bulk via CSV upload from Company Settings. It also documents Classes with unlimited Groups, which gives a class/tag dimension. The evidence does not show account types or sub-account hierarchies, so the COA customization the story describes is only partly shown. Missing for 10: documented account-type configuration, sub-account/parent-child structure, in-app individual COA editing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
